method: Real configured-provider production text translation; unique synthetic inputs; no screenshot data, credentials, source text or full model outputs retained. Stage attribution is by timestamp and process ID; background refill can overlap the next sample.
verificationCommands: go test <all internal/translator production .go files> internal/translator/runtime_api_test.go -run ^TestLocalConfiguredRuntimeAPISoak$ -count=1 -v -timeout 5m (isolated harness excludes unrelated image-test imports; same production translator/Codex/config pipeline)

interpretation.timeoutFix: Arm response idle timeout only once input is ready (or assistant activity starts), not when local turn scheduling is acknowledged. Repeated echoed input cannot reset it. Overall configured60s deadline remains.
interpretation.scope: Real synthetic text translations through saved Codex gpt-6-luna/low/fast settings. No screenshot data or global settings changes.
interpretation.limits: Small uncontrolled cohort; network/server and machine load vary. Compilation/link time excluded. Prior failures are retained; this does not establish a universal latency or long-run reliability guarantee.

runtimeIsolationEvidence.featureListObservation: Installed CLI features list recognizes skip_host_skill_discovery as under development; per-process override was accepted and both optimized translations completed.
runtimeIsolationEvidence.scope: Child-process and ephemeral-thread overrides only; saved app settings, CODEX_HOME, auth.json and global Codex configuration were not changed.
runtimeIsolationEvidence.schemaEvidence: Installed app-server generated v2/ThreadStartParams.json allows arbitrary JSON config overrides. Existing thread isolation rechecks config/read and disables inherited MCP server names.
runtimeIsolationEvidence.compatibility: The skip-host-discovery flag is installed-runtime evidence, not a documented stable cross-version guarantee. Existing startup error handling reports unsupported CLI initialization without exposing credentials.
